name: Fibonacci-type recursion
whenToUse: Counting stair climbs with steps of $1$ or $2$, tilings with $1 \times 1$ and $1 \times 2$ pieces, or strings with no two adjacent $1$s. Ask what the last move was.
example: Ways to climb $8$ stairs taking $1$ or $2$ at a time: start with $a_1 = 1$, $a_2 = 2$, then $3, 5, 8, 13, 21, 34$. So $a_8 = 34$.
pitfall: Get the starting values right; they depend on the problem, and a shift by one gives the wrong answer. Write out $a_1$ to $a_4$ by hand to check.
